test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question: Which of the following Articles of the Constitution of India declares the age of 35 years as one of the eligibility criteria for the post of the President of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 58.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• According to **Article 58** of the Constitution, no person shall be accepted for election as President unless he is a citizen of India, has completed the age of **thirty-five years,** and is certified for election as a member of the House of the People.
 
• The president is **indirectly elected by an electoral college comprising both houses of the Parliament **of India and the legislative assemblies of each of India's states and territories.
 
• Under **Article 324 **of the Constitution of India, the authority to** conduct elections to the Office of Presiden**t is vested in the Election Commission of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 61** of the Constitution of India **orders the process for the impeachment of the President. **
 
• **Article 56** mentions that the President shall hold **office for a term of five years** from the date on which he enters upon his office**.​ **
 
• **Article 60** of the Indian Constitution orders the Oath or affirmation by the President.
